Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/watch: one outcome per room requested, in the order requested. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/watch/0.2#response.
Response.title: Rooms Keys — Watch — response payload

RoomWatchOutcome.description: What became of one room of the request.

armed.description: `true`: the host holds the watch armed and the recipient will pass on its signal with rooms/keys/changed — the first for a one-shot watch, every one for a live watch (`live`). `false`: the watch was cancelled, there was none to cancel, or it was refused (`refused` says why).

expiresAt.description: Present when `armed` is `true`: when the watch lapses if it has not fired, or, for a live watch, when it ends unless renewed — the expiresAt the host answered, or earlier where the recipient bounds it. The caller re-arms or renews before then if it still wants signals.

hostCode.description: Present when `refused` is `hostRefused`: the code of the host's trust-task-error, unaltered — for instance `rooms/watch:limitReached`, `rooms/watch:liveNotPermitted` (a live watch on a room whose signal delay is not `none`; the caller MAY arm it one-shot instead) or the standard `permissionDenied`.

live.description: Present when the room's watch is armed live — only when the host answered `live: true`. Absent when it is one-shot, including when a key holder or host that implements only 0.1 armed a one-shot watch for a live request: a caller treats a watch as live only when this says so.

refused.description: Present when this room's watch was not armed or cancelled because of a refusal. `notAMember`: the recipient holds no credential the room issued to `member`. `actionNotHeld`: the member's credentials do not confer `read`. `limitReached`: the recipient holds as many watches as it allows — the caller polls this room. `hostUnreachable`: the host could not be resolved, advertises no transport the recipient speaks, or did not answer — a retry may succeed. `hostRefused`: the host answered with a trust-task-error, whose code is in `hostCode`.

RoomWatchOutcome.title: Outcome for one room

RoomWatchRequest.description: One room of the request, with the version the caller has read it to.

sinceVersion.description: The highest version of the room the caller has read to, passed to the host as rooms/watch's sinceVersion: the host signals as soon as the room is above it, at once if it already is. Absent means the room's latest version when the host arms the watch. Ignored on a cancel.

RoomWatchRequest.title: Room to watch

schema.description: A member's own client asks the member's key holder to arm, re-arm, renew or cancel rooms/watch at one host for one or more rooms, as the member, with an address the key holder controls — one-shot, or live (`live: true`) for a conversation on screen; the key holder passes each signal on to the client with rooms/keys/changed: the first for a one-shot watch, every one for a live watch. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cancel.description: End the watches on the named rooms, one-shot or live. Only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted. A cancel of a watch the recipient does not hold succeeds with `armed: false`.

host.description: The host to arm the watches at, as a DID. Named by the caller for the reason it is on rooms/keys/browse: nothing maps a room to its host.

leaseSeconds.description: How long the caller asks each watch to last if it does not fire, in seconds, up to 30 days. Passed to the host as rooms/watch's leaseSeconds; the host and the recipient MAY grant less, and a host grants a live watch at most 120 seconds. Absent means the host's default. Ignored on a cancel.

live.description: Arm, or renew, every named room's watch live: the recipient arms rooms/watch with `live: true` and passes on every signal the host sends until the watch ends, not just the first. Only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted; a one-shot request omits the member. For a room its person has open on screen, on a room whose signal delay is `none` — a host refuses it otherwise, reported as `hostRefused` with `hostCode` `rooms/watch:liveNotPermitted`. Renewed by sending the room again with `live: true` before `expiresAt`. Ignored on a cancel.

member.description: The member to watch as: a DID the recipient holds keys for and the caller may act as. Always named — the recipient never picks a member for the caller. This task's subject.

rooms.description: The rooms to watch at this host, each at most once. Each is armed at the host with its own rooms/watch request, presentation and address; the host never sees them together.
